versions.name: Leatherwork
versions.description: Cut, punch, stamp, dye, and lace leather into finished articles, braid a lace or paracord piece, and learn where hides come from and how tanning turns skin into workable material.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
